name: Dominic Maker
description: '''Dominic Patrick Maker''' (born 12 September 1986) is an English record producer and songwriter from [[Chichester]].  He is known for his production work for artists such as [[James Blake (musician)|James Blake]], Lil Yachty, [[Slowthai]], [[Rosalía (singer)|Rosalía]], Travis Scott and [[Jay-Z]]. He performs as part of James Blake’s live band and was also one half of the duo [[Mount Kimbie]].
